'''Presbalin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Presbalin system/Legends|Presbalin system]]. It was situated in the [[Loop Worlds]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Junction-Tierell Loop/Legends|Junction-Tierell Loop]] connected it to the [[Near Indosa system/Legends|Near Indosa system]] as well as the [[Tierell system/Legends|Tierell system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Thesme sector/Legends|Thesme sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>

At one point, an [[Alien/Legends|alien]] culture abandoned a large number of [[City/Legends|cities]] at Presbalin. The planet's [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] subsequently found the settlements perfectly suitable for habitation. However, while some of the world's visitors found the cities' architecture to be aesthetically pleasing, others viewed it as eerie and frightening. Presbalin eventually became the commercial hub of the Loop Worlds, and during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to<ref name="TEA" /> [[43 ABY]],<ref name="43 ABY">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which describes Presbalin, ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of ''Outcast'' are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] attempted to find a stable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route from it to the [[Pinoora system/Legends|Pinoora system]] through the highly ionized [[Gas/Legends|gases]] of the nearby [[Denarii Nebula/Legends|Denarii Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Presbalin was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
